help.title: How to use
help.subtitle: Steps for the project owner and contributors

github.title: Prepare the repo (owner)
github.text: Keep the project in a GitHub repo. Open each piece of work as an issue labelled "cockpit-task", optionally with an estimate label like "est:2h". Invite contributors or make the repo public.
github.cmd: gh issue create -R owner/project --title "Light theme" --label cockpit-task --label est:4h

github.title: Sign in to GitHub (everyone)
github.text: The cockpit acts with your own GitHub login.

github.title: Clone the repo
github.text: Task branches are created in this folder.

github.title: Connect it here
github.text: Choose GitHub; enter the repo, the absolute path of your clone and the task label, then save.

github.title: Pick your agent, claim a task
github.text: Choose Claude Code, Codex or Cursor under the summary and press "Claim and start" on an open task. It is assigned to you, a task/<n> branch is created and the Run page opens with the task text. If someone claimed it first you get a warning.

github.title: Start the agent and watch
github.text: Check the command on the Run page and press Run. Follow progress on Dashboard, Sessions and the live stream. The agent does not push; that step needs your confirmation.

github.title: Send the PR and track it
github.text: Press the PR icon in Mine: commits and commands are shown, and on confirm a PR that closes the issue is opened. Each row shows who claimed it and when, and the PR review state. When the PR is merged the task moves to Recently done and the progress bar grows.

gitlab.title: Prepare the project (owner)
gitlab.text: Keep the project on GitLab. Open each piece of work as an issue labelled "cockpit-task", optionally with "est:2h". Add contributors as members.
gitlab.cmd: glab issue create -R group/project -t "Light theme" -l cockpit-task,est:4h

gitlab.title: Install glab and sign in (everyone)
gitlab.text: The cockpit talks to GitLab with your glab login. Pick your own host during login if you self-host.
gitlab.cmd:
brew install glab
glab auth login

gitlab.title: Clone the project
gitlab.text: Task branches are created in this folder.

gitlab.title: Connect it here
gitlab.text: Choose GitLab; enter group/project, your clone path, the label and the host if needed, then save.

gitlab.title: Pick your agent, claim a task
gitlab.text: Choose Claude Code, Codex or Cursor under the summary and press "Claim and start" on an open task. It is assigned to you, a task/<n> branch is created and the Run page opens with the task text. If someone claimed it first you get a warning.

gitlab.title: Start the agent and watch
gitlab.text: Check the command on the Run page and press Run. Follow progress on Dashboard, Sessions and the live stream. The agent does not push; that step needs your confirmation.

gitlab.title: Send the MR and track it
gitlab.text: Press the MR icon in Mine: commits and commands are shown, and on confirm a merge request that closes the issue is opened. Rows show who claimed it and the last activity. When the MR is merged the task moves to Recently done.

local.title: Prepare the plan file
local.text: Put a plan Markdown file in the repo. "## Phase" headings are phases, "### Task 3: Title (est:2h)" headings are tasks.
local.cmd:
## Phase 1
### Task 1: Login screen (est:2h)
### Task 2: Settings

local.title: Connect it here
local.text: Choose Local git; enter the repo path and the plan file path inside the repo, then save. No remote needed.

local.title: Pick your agent, claim a task
local.text: Choose Claude Code, Codex or Cursor under the summary and press "Claim and start" on an open task. It is assigned to you, a task/<n> branch is created and the Run page opens with the task text. If someone claimed it first you get a warning.

local.title: Start the agent and watch
local.text: Check the command on the Run page and press Run. Follow progress on Dashboard, Sessions and the live stream. The agent does not push; that step needs your confirmation.

local.title: Merge and track
local.text: Press the merge icon in Mine: commits and the git commands are shown, and on confirm the task branch is merged into the main branch and the task moves to Recently done. Claims live on this machine only; use GitHub or GitLab for team work.
